reviewer: Second native GPT-6.1 Sol reviewer; actual arranged WebGL art/state/layout review, not a human participant
build: Build12 authored induction Warden before parent attachment and body-hit correctness followups

ratings.reason: The new Warden is a concrete asset/rig improvement over the layered drone: fixed protected optic, joined chassis, machined perimeter and rear cooling detail. Whole-game presentation still uses a simple box-and-circle enemy silhouette, clean uniform material surfaces, rigid sliding skids, basic handling and one shared courtyard. Readable amber/cyan state and an unobstructed ADS target preserve usability but do not establish a broader increase in enjoyment, fidelity, content depth or readiness. Keeping the same whole-game rubric and provisional scores is appropriate; asset budget/test success does not imply an overall perfect game.

methods: Read README, Build11/10/09/08 dossier context, Build10 normal/physics reports, reproducible Blender asset script, runtime rig and game combat/material code.

Inspected all14 actual parent-authored browser captures at1280x800 and1440x900: hip, ADS, close, charging, stagger, open and recovery. These use test=1, explicit enemy/player/state fixtures, controlled RAF and direct simulation, not normal play.

Independently ran installed Chrome headless/Playwright with actual Three/WebGL software rendering at both desktop sizes. Created and inspected10 additional actual screenshots: low charge, high open, high side, high rear, and high near-cover. Captures use explicitly arranged state/position and known simulation intervals. Browser closed after capture.
Low quality disables shadows; high enables them. This validates visual behavior on software-rendered fixtures, not target-hardware frame rate.
Measured actual GLB bounds and named precision anchor. Audited clone ownership and mesh budget using parent raw observations, not a claim of independent performance measurement.

Independently traced36 explicitly arranged local frontal rays against actual exported triangles and existing0.68m body sphere at four heights. This identifies visible armor outside logical damage volume; no game damage/health rules or source were changed.

Near-cover fixture positioned guard near ingress props atx2,z23 and sampled0.2s enemy update; no collider/AABB overlap found in that arrangement. This is adjacency evidence, not an exhaustive autonomous-navigation or stage-reachability review.
verifiedImprovements: Visible runtime assembly contains authored model and point light; the duplicate drone/shoulder/ring/sphere additions are hidden when authored Warden loads.

Final asset measures15,484 triangles,7 mesh/material primitives and6 materials, with shared clone geometry and separate disposable material instances. No downloaded geometry or textures are referenced by the reproducible authoring script.

Fixed optic anchor exports to localThree(0,2,0.300000012); checked parent14-pose measurements and own10 fixtures agree. Upper iris remains ahead and visible through ADS aperture at both desktop sizes.
Optic has a readable manufactured bezel/iris rather than a floating sphere. Side/rear renders show supported neck, cooling fins and fan; lower struts meet skids within a0.015m floor offset.
Amber idle/charge and cyan stagger/open materials retain visible hue and iris/rib detail, without white emitter blowout. Measured emission0.7 idle,1.5 charge,1.1 open.

Paired shutters retract/roll slightly to show physical state; fixed optic stays unaffected. Source uses exponential easing and recovery captures show closed posture rather than a snapped target shift.
Base local width1.498m is narrower than prior1.74m primitive shoulders. No blocker was observed in labeled nearby-cover arrangement, and source keeps existing grounded navigation behavior.

findings.finding: Visible authored shoulder armor extends outside the existing spherical body damage volume. Actual triangle probes hit ArmorRight but the logical sphere misses atx0.65,y1.0; x0.65–0.72,y1.6; x0.60–0.68,y1.75. This creates unfair-looking misses when aiming at visible armor. Opening shutters widens the body further. The precision optic itself remains correctly centered and its0.24m sphere must not be enlarged.
findings.recommendation: Use authored Warden body surface intersections or another measured body-volume correction while preserving17/34 body damage,82 precision damage,150 Standard health and unchanged optic radius. Add an explicit regression on these previously missed visible points.
findings.status: reported to parent; source held stable during review

findings.finding: Brass EdgeInset strips remain in the static Brass batch while ArmorLeft/Right translate and roll. In open-state captures the strips sit inward of the moving shutter edges instead of following the attached-looking surface.
findings.recommendation: Join these strips into the corresponding moving rigid shutter without increasing material primitives; a restrained armor-colored inset is acceptable.
findings.status: reported to parent; parent plans small post-review correction without rescoring

findings.finding: The authored legs/skids move rigidly with the group while fallback legs alone receive walking rotation. This still reads as sliding a toy-like machine across the floor. The face/chest is two bright concentric disks and the clean beveled box shoulders retain a simplified procedural aesthetic.
findings.recommendation: A later authored locomotion/actuation pass should make ground travel credible and add carefully designed surface variation, after preserving fixed optic alignment and combat timing. Do not label this realism/photogrammetry or AAA production art.

findings.finding: Charge physical movement is a small inward2.5cm shutter compression; the dominant charge cue remains HUD text and brighter amber. Open motion is visible at close range but modest at typical firing distance.
findings.recommendation: Human-visible timing tests should assess whether players can perceive physical charge/open changes without relying on the CHARGING label before increasing motion or brightness.

limitations: No normal-input combat or complete mission in this reviewer; separate visible-cue combat reviewer covers that distinct scope.
All new visual captures and ray probes explicitly arrange state/positions through test=1. Knowledge of model structure, prior screenshots and source is a substantial advantage.
Still images plus state samples/source establish poses and easing implementation, not human perception of animation timing or enjoyment.
No human audio listening, blind learning, hardware performance certification, comprehensive accessibility study, exhaustive cover-seam search or commercial AAA-readiness claim.
Ratings cover the whole existing prototype and remain provisional; no10/10 claim, no asset-only rating relabeled as whole game.
Raw review precedes parent fixes. Any later fix/retest is parent evidence and does not silently replace these observations or imply another independent review.
